title: IRIS Data Center
menascoScope: The IRIS Data Center (A100) project is a prefabricated modular data centre campus in Abu Dhabi, comprising four data centre buildings delivered to Uptime Institute Tier III standards. This additional works package covered the rebuild of the IRIS 4 data centre building at the IRIS Data Center campus in Abu Dhabi, a prefabricated modular data centre development. MENASCO, which delivered the MEP works for the original campus, executed the MEP works for the rebuild. This additional works package at the IRIS Data Center campus in Abu Dhabi covered the construction of dedicated battery rooms for the IRIS data centre buildings, supporting the facility's backup power infrastructure. MENASCO carried out the construction works as an extension of its main MEP contract on the modular data centre campus. This additional works package extended MENASCO's involvement at the IRIS Data Center (A100) campus in Abu Dhabi, a prefabricated modular data centre development. description: A prefabricated modular data centre campus in Abu Dhabi, assembled from 552 factory-built units arranged across four separate data centre buildings. The campus carries around 18MW of IT capacity and is designed to Uptime Institute Tier III standards for concurrent maintainability. It is configured for mission-critical workloads that need resilient, high-availability capacity. A hyperscale campus, this building was stripped back and rebuilt to current design standards, restoring its white space, power and cooling infrastructure. Modular construction of this kind allows each building on such a campus to be delivered, replaced or returned to service quickly, supporting cloud, enterprise and high-density workloads for the regional market. The battery rooms at the IRIS Data Center campus in Abu Dhabi house the stored-energy plant that holds the site's critical load during a mains interruption, bridging the gap until standby generation picks up. They sit within a prefabricated modular data centre development whose halls are assembled from factory-built units. Dedicated, environmentally controlled battery accommodation of this kind is a standard requirement for facilities targeting Uptime Institute Tier III resilience. This campus is a prefabricated modular development in which the halls are assembled from factory-built units and joined by common site services. The external areas carry the access routes, utility corridors and hardstanding that let the buildings run as a single high-availability facility.

Shared amenities include swimming pools, a gymnasium, a jogging track, a children's play area, a multi-purpose hall and a landscaped deck.

title: Noor Tower Business Bay
menascoScope: Noor Tower is a 20-storey residential building on the Dubai Water Canal in Business Bay, developed by Al Ansari Real Estate and designed by APG Architecture & Planning Group. Sixteen residential floors sit above a ground floor and three podium levels, with amenities including a swimming pool and gym. MENASCO carried out the MEP works for the building.
description: Noor Tower is a 20-storey residential building on the Dubai Water Canal in Business Bay, Dubai, with sixteen apartment floors above a ground floor and three podium parking levels. Around 124 one- to three-bedroom apartments and duplexes range from roughly 1,000 to 3,300 square feet across some 33,400 square metres. Amenities include a swimming pool, gymnasium, sauna and steam rooms, a business centre and a children's play area.

title: Bloom Towers
menascoScope: Bloom Towers is a three-tower residential development by Bloom Properties in Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai, with 944 apartments set above a shared four-level podium. Tower A rises 39 floors and Towers B and C 29 floors each, supported by amenities including pools, gyms and a co-working space. MENASCO carried out the MEP works for the development, which was completed in 2020.
description: Bloom Towers is a three-tower residential development in Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai, with 944 apartments arranged above a shared ground floor and four-level podium. Tower A rises 39 floors while Towers B and C reach 29 each, giving overall heights of 44 and 34 storeys. Residents share swimming pools, gymnasiums, a landscaped podium deck and a co-working area, with retail units at street level.

title: Avani Palm View Dubai
mainContractor: Ali & Sons Contracting Company - Sole Proprietorship LLC
menascoScope: The Al Sufouh Mixed-Use Development is a high-rise tower on a TECOM plot in Al Sufouh, Dubai, with two basements, a ground floor, four podium levels and 43 upper floors beneath the roof. It was developed for Al Fahim with AECOM Middle East as consultant. MENASCO carried out the MEP works for the tower.
description: Avani Palm View Dubai Hotel & Suites is a 48-storey hotel and serviced-apartment tower in Al Sufouh 2, beside Dubai Media City and facing the entrance to Palm Jumeirah. It offers 264 rooms, suites and apartments in eleven layouts, from 440-square-foot studios to four-bedroom homes of about 1,750 square feet. Facilities include a dual-level infinity pool, a gymnasium, restaurants and a cafe, with the Dubai Tram and Palm Monorail close by.

title: Burj Royale
menascoScope: Rising around 215 metres, Burj Royale is a high-rise residential tower developed by Emaar Properties on one of the last remaining plots in Downtown Dubai, offering one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments above a multi-level podium. MENASCO served as MEP contractor on the project, delivering the MEP works for the tower, which was completed in 2022.
description: Burj Royale is a 58-storey residential tower in Downtown Dubai, rising almost 215 metres on one of the district's last remaining plots. It holds 215 one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments above a four-level podium, across roughly 55,800 square metres of built area. Residents overlook Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Fountain and the Opera District, with The Dubai Mall a short walk away. The tower was completed in 2022.

title: Jafza Traders Market
menascoScope: Jafza Traders Market is a hybrid retail and wholesale trading hub developed by DP World in Sectors 7 and 8 of Jebel Ali Free Zone, forming part of the wider Dubai Traders Market masterplan. Its first phase opened in 2022 as Yiwu Market, combining showrooms with warehouses served by dedicated loading docks. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the development.
description: Jafza Traders Market is a wholesale and retail trading hub in Sectors 7 and 8 of Jebel Ali Free Zone, Dubai, and the first phase of the wider Dubai Traders Market masterplan. Opened in 2022 as Yiwu Market, it spans about 200,000 square metres over two floors, with 1,600 showrooms backed by 324 customs-bonded warehouses. Each warehouse has its own loading dock, and showrooms are grouped by category across five atriums.

title: PCFC HQ
client: PORTS, CUSTOMS. & FREE ZONE CORPORATION / DP WORLD
mainContractor: Asia Prime General Contracting Co. L.L.C.
menascoScope: The PCFC Headquarters is the new head office of Dubai's Ports, Customs and Free Zone Corporation in Dubai Maritime City, comprising a G+9+R office building and a G+6+R multi-storey car park with more than 700 parking spaces. The LEED Gold-certified complex accommodates over 1,500 employees. MENASCO executed the MEP works across Shell & Core and office fit-out, covering HVAC, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems.
description: PCFC Headquarters is the head office of Dubai's Ports, Customs and Free Zone Corporation, set in Dubai Maritime City beside Mina Rashid. It pairs a ten-storey office building with a separate multi-storey car park holding more than 700 spaces, and accommodates over 1,500 staff while handling some 300 visitors a day. The LEED Gold-rated complex also contains a museum, a library and public-facing service areas, and was inaugurated in December 2024.

title: Jadeel Madinat Jumeirah Living
menascoScope: Madinat Jumeirah Living Phase 3B comprises three residential buildings, Jadeel 1, 2 and 3, within Dubai Holding's Madinat Jumeirah Living community in Umm Suqeim, close to Burj Al Arab. MENASCO executed the complete MEP scope, covering engineering, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of HVAC, electrical, plumbing and firefighting systems, including centralised cooling and building automation. The phase was completed in 2025.
description: Jadeel is the third phase of Madinat Jumeirah Living, a low-rise residential community in Umm Suqeim 3, a short walk from Madinat Jumeirah and Burj Al Arab. The phase comprises three buildings, Jadeel 1 to 3, rising to between seven and ten storeys and holding one- to four-bedroom apartments. Residents share landscaped walkways, shaded courtyards, swimming pools, gyms, a community centre and basement parking. The buildings were handed over in 2025.

title: Volante Tower II
menascoScope: Volante II is an ultra-luxury residential tower on the Dubai Water Canal in Business Bay, offering a limited collection of high-end residences with views towards Burj Khalifa. MENASCO executed the complete MEP works, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting and low-current systems, with chilled water, smart-building controls and integrated life-safety solutions supporting long-term comfort and operational efficiency.
description: Volante II is an ultra-luxury residential tower on the Dubai Water Canal in Business Bay, rising 36 storeys above two basement parking levels. It holds a deliberately small number of large apartments, laid out to take canal, city and Burj Khalifa views. Residents' facilities include a private cinema, a club lounge, a spa and gym, and an outdoor terrace overlooking the water, reached through a double-height lobby.

title: Bay Residences Phase I
location: Mina Al Arab, Ras Al Khaimah, UAE
menascoScope: Bay Residences is a seafront residential development by RAK Properties on Hayat Island in Mina Al Arab, Ras Al Khaimah, offering studio to three-bedroom and duplex apartments with Arabian Gulf views across 648 homes. Phase I, completed in 2024, formed the first stage of the development. MENASCO executed the MEP works for Phase I. Bay Residences is a seafront residential development by RAK Properties on Hayat Island in Mina Al Arab, Ras Al Khaimah, offering studio to three-bedroom and duplex apartments with Arabian Gulf views. Phase II comprises Towers 3 and 4, which were in the final stages of completion in 2026. MENASCO executed the MEP works for both towers.
description: Bay Residences is a seafront apartment development on Hayat Island at Mina Al Arab, Ras Al Khaimah, built directly behind a stretch of beach on the Arabian Gulf. Phase I delivered 324 homes, from studios to three-bedroom and duplex units, sized between roughly 50 and 340 square metres. Shared facilities include swimming pools, a gym, children's play areas, landscaped walks and parks, and ground-floor shops and restaurants. Bay Residences Phase II adds Towers 3 and 4 to the seafront apartment development on Hayat Island at Mina Al Arab, Ras Al Khaimah. The two buildings hold 324 studio to three-bedroom and duplex homes, taking the scheme to 648 apartments across both phases. Residents have direct beach access along with swimming pools, a gym, play areas, landscaped walkways and ground-level shops and restaurants, with two resort hotels a short walk away.

title: Marina Development Plot 4E
description: Plot 4E forms part of the Dubai Marina development, the waterfront district built around an artificial canal cut inland from the Gulf coast between Sheikh Zayed Road and Jumeirah Beach Residence. The masterplan sets residential and mixed-use towers around the marina itself, with a waterside promenade and podium-level retail running through the district. Plot 4E is one of the individually numbered development parcels within that grid.

title: DMCC Uptown Place Twin Towers
mainContractor: Ali & Sons Contracting Company - Sole Proprietorship LLC
menascoScope: Towers T3 and T4 form part of Phase 2 of Uptown Dubai District, DMCC's landmark mixed-use destination beside Jumeirah Lakes Towers. MENASCO was entrusted with the full MEP scope, covering the engineering, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of HVAC, electrical, plumbing and firefighting systems, with integrated building automation designed to support the district's commercial, retail and hospitality functions efficiently.
description: One Uptown Place and Two Uptown Place are twin commercial towers of 21 and 15 storeys in the Uptown Dubai district, next to Jumeirah Lakes Towers. Together they add more than 560,000 sq ft of Grade A office space and 82,000 sq ft of retail, with floor plates ranging from 2,100 to 17,600 sq ft. Amenities include in-building dining, a swimming pool and more than 1,600 parking spaces, and both towers target LEED Gold certification.

title: Alba Residences
menascoScope: The Alba Residences is an ultra-luxury beachfront development by OMNIYAT on Palm Jumeirah, designed by Zaha Hadid Architects with landscape design by Vladimir Djurovic and managed by Dorchester Collection. Conceived around the themes of water and light, the scheme offers 88 simplex, duplex and super-penthouse residences. MENASCO is responsible for the MEP works on the development.
description: The Alba Residences is an ultra-luxury beachfront development on the Crescent of Palm Jumeirah in Dubai, comprising three low-rise buildings of nine and ten storeys set within roughly 26,000 square metres of landscaped grounds. It offers 88 simplex and duplex homes together with penthouses, and day-to-day services are managed by the Dorchester Collection. Amenities include a private beach, a wellness centre of about 3,000 square metres and beachfront dining. Completion is expected in 2028.

title: Coastline Substation
menascoScope: The Coastline 132/11 kV Substation is a primary power substation delivered for Meraas, the Dubai-based master developer. MENASCO delivered the MEP works for the substation building, with Energoprojekt Entel as consultant. The building services support the safe, reliable operation of high-voltage equipment, forming part of a series of Meraas substations on which MENASCO has worked.
description: Coastline is a 132/11 kV primary substation on Dubai's high-voltage transmission network. It takes in power at 132 kV and steps it down to 11 kV for distribution to the homes, hotels, shops and public facilities in the district around it. Like other primary substations in the city, it is built as an enclosed, indoor station, allowing it to sit close to occupied buildings without an open switchyard.

title: Franck Muller Yachting
client: LONDON GATE REAL ESTATE DEVELOPMENT LLC
mainContractor: AFAQ ENGINEERING FOR BUILDING CONTRACTING LLC
menascoScope: Franck Muller Yachting is a branded residential tower by London Gate in Dubai Maritime City, set between Port Rashid and Dubai Dry Docks and themed around Franck Muller's Swiss watchmaking heritage. The tower offers around 574 studio, one- and two-bedroom apartments with waterfront amenities. MENASCO is responsible for the MEP works on the project.
description: Franck Muller Yachting is a 36-storey branded residential tower in Dubai Maritime City, a waterfront district between Port Rashid and the Dubai Dry Docks. Themed around the Swiss watchmaker's design language, it holds about 574 fully furnished studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, along with a small number of duplexes and penthouses. Residents' facilities include rooftop pools, a padel court, an outdoor cinema and landscaped gardens. Handover is scheduled for 2028.

title: King's College Hospital Dubai
menascoScope: King's College Hospital London – Dubai is expanding its multi-specialty hospital in Dubai Hills through a multi-year programme that adds capacity for oncology, complex liver disease, critical care and precision medicine, together with additional operating theatres. The hospital remains fully operational throughout construction. MENASCO is responsible for the MEP works on the expansion.
description: King's College Hospital London - Dubai is a JCI-accredited British multi-specialty hospital in Dubai Hills, off Al Khail Road, currently operating around 100 inpatient beds. A major expansion under way will roughly double bed capacity to about 200 and add operating theatres, together with dedicated centres for oncology, complex liver disease, critical care and precision medicine. The hospital remains fully open to patients throughout the works, which are due to complete in 2028.
